clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors for the Horde. He tests them against the silithid in the southern Barrens before sending the proven toward custom armor.

At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors who want to prove their strength in Kalimdor. Silithid have suddenly appeared to the south, carving hives into the Field of Giants. Ruga sends young fighters to hunt the insectoids and cut off their antennae. Those who endure the trial earn his respect and a recommendation to Thun'grim Firegaze, a renowned armorsmith.
